source.title: File:Striking a bell 15cm large.ogg
source.author: stephan (via pdsounds.org)
source.file_url: https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/transcoded/2/2c/Striking_a_bell_15cm_large.ogg/Striking_a_bell_15cm_large.ogg.mp3 (Wikimedia's own mp3 transcode of the original https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/2/2c/Striking_a_bell_15cm_large.ogg, which returned HTTP 429 twice)
source.what_it_shows: a 60.9 s recording of a small (15 cm) bell struck several times; the loudest strike at 46.37 s is isolated (room tone at about -52 dB for 1 s before it) and rings clean for more than 10 s; partials about 381, 1110, 2199/2244 (beating pair), 3529 Hz: inharmonic, a bell
source.verified_date_or_place: Commons API extmetadata read 2026-11-17: LicenseShortName 'Public domain', Artist 'stephan', Credit http://www.pdsounds.org/audio/download/517/bell.mp3 (PDSounds), DateTimeOriginal 2008-05-04, original ogg 1,513,331 bytes sha1 ab316b7964524e798ef9d0beba9d3f19006e7850, 60.89 s
source.used_as: one real bell strike, trimmed (onset 46.295 s, 1.45 s long, 0.35 s squared fade-out) and levelled only (peak -14.5 dBFS in the wav, -14.5 dBFS after AAC); cued at F126, F246, F426 (W1, W2, W3); declared digital silence elsewhere

processing: ffmpeg decode (mp3 -> s16le mono 44.1 kHz); numpy trim, squared fade-out, single gain to peak -14.5 dBFS; nothing else
elsewhere: declared digital silence (0 nonzero samples outside the three cue spans, measured)

levels.evidence: measured (sample values of the rendered beds)

silent_variant: /home/user/bolas/paeleo/scion/oulipo/films/sources/anemic-cinema/switch/test-shot-silent.mp4 (all samples zero; peak -91 dB in the AAC decode)
rejected: The earlier station bell (File:Glockenschlagwerk Bahnhof Fridingen.ogg, Olga Ernst, CC BY-SA 4.0, re-verified 2026-11-17) was rejected for the film: its strikes are a mechanical double hit damped to -40 dB in 0.45 s, short of the ~1.2 s ring asked for. It is no longer used and not credited.
